lines.serbian: Tanja i Ivana su najbolje drugarice.
lines.croatian: Tanja i Ivana su najbolje prijateljice.
lines.english: Tanja and Ivana are best friends.
Every Saturday they go for coffee.

lines.serbian: Danas su u novom kafiću blizu parka.
lines.croatian: Danas su u novom kafiću blizu parka.
lines.english: Today they're at a new café near the park.
"Two coffees, please."

lines.serbian: – Želite li i kolač? – pita konobar.
lines.croatian: – Želite li i kolač? – pita konobar.
lines.english: "Would you like cake too?" asks the waiter.

lines.serbian: – Ne, hvala. Na dijeti sam – kaže Tanja.
lines.croatian: – Ne, hvala. Na dijeti sam – kaže Tanja.
lines.english: "No, thanks. I'm on a diet," says Tanja.
"Me too," says Ivana.
The waiter leaves.

lines.serbian: Na drugom stolu je velika čokoladna torta.
lines.croatian: Na drugom stolu je velika čokoladna torta.
lines.english: There's a big chocolate cake on another table.

lines.serbian: Tanja gleda tortu. Ivana gleda tortu.
lines.croatian: Tanja gleda tortu. Ivana gleda tortu.
lines.english: Tanja looks at the cake. Ivana looks at the cake.
"It looks nice," says Tanja.

lines.serbian: – Samo jedan mali komad? – pita Ivana.
lines.croatian: – Samo jedan mali komad? – pita Ivana.
lines.english: "Just one small piece?" asks Ivana.
"One piece and two forks?"
They call the waiter.
"One piece of cake, please."

lines.serbian: Konobar donosi tortu i dve viljuške.
lines.croatian: Konobar donosi tortu i dvije vilice.
lines.english: The waiter brings the cake and two forks.
The cake disappears in two minutes.

lines.serbian: – Mali komad je bio mali – kaže Tanja.
lines.croatian: – Mali komad je bio mali – kaže Tanja.
lines.english: "The small piece was small," says Tanja.
Ivana raises her hand.
"Another piece, please!"
"What about the diet?" asks the waiter.
"The diet starts on Monday!"
